trait.da_18_adaptor.description:
Innate: Adaptor abilities change depending on if their Attack Damage or Ability Power is higher.
Adaptors gain Ability Power or Attack Damage, depending on which is higher.
trait.da_18_adaptor.name: Adaptor
trait.da_18_apexpredator.description: Elder Dragon takes up 2 team slots and grants +2 to the Riftbeast trait.
trait.da_18_apexpredator.name: Apex Predator
trait.da_18_battlemage.description: Monoliths gain 10 Armor and Magic Resist for each enemy targeting them.
trait.da_18_battlemage.name: Monolith
trait.da_18_blackthorn.description:
The ally on the Blackthorn hex is sacrificed before combat, granting your champions Health.
Blackthorn champions gain additional stats based on the sacrifice's Role, Star Level, and Cost.
trait.da_18_blackthorn.name: Blackthorn
trait.da_18_blossom.breakpoint.11.descri: Wisps overflow with power, 100% AD AP
trait.da_18_blossom.breakpoint.5.descrip: Wisps are in every shop, 30% AD AP
trait.da_18_blossom.breakpoint.7.descrip: Gain 4 gold after buying a Wisp, 45% AD AP
trait.da_18_blossom.breakpoint.9.descrip: You can buy 2 Wisps per round, 50% AD AP
trait.da_18_blossom.description:
After combat, your Wisps are empowered.
Blossom champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, and 10% max Health.
trait.da_18_blossom.name: Blossom
trait.da_18_brawler.description: Your team gains 120 max Health. Brawlers gain more.
trait.da_18_brawler.name: Brawler
trait.da_18_caustic.description:
Caustic damage 30% Shreds and Sunders enemies for 4 seconds.
Shred: Reduce Magic Resist
Sunder: Reduce Armor
trait.da_18_caustic.name: Caustic
trait.da_18_coven.breakpoint.3.descripti: 2 Essence per kill, 22 Essence per loss
trait.da_18_coven.description:
Gather Essence by killing champions, plus more by losing player combat.
Beginning at 40 Essence, choose to convert Essence to rewards or continue gathering Essence. Each reward requires increasing amounts of Essence.
trait.da_18_coven.name: Coven
trait.da_18_defender.description: Your team gains 12 Armor and Magic Resist. Defenders gain more.
trait.da_18_defender.name: Defender
trait.da_18_eclipse.description: After 10 seconds of combat, the Eclipse kills the lowest Health enemy, repeating every 3.5 seconds.
trait.da_18_eclipse.name: Eclipse
trait.da_18_elderwood.breakpoint.11.desc: Plants star up to 3-star and the forest comes to life
trait.da_18_elderwood.breakpoint.3.descr: A Stonebark Tree and a Lifebloom
trait.da_18_elderwood.breakpoint.5.descr: A second Stonebark Tree and Stonebark Trees gain 200 Health
trait.da_18_elderwood.name: Elderwood
trait.da_18_executioner.breakpoint.2.des: Executioners gain Precision and 15% Critical Strike Chance.
trait.da_18_executioner.breakpoint.3.des: Additionally, enemies bleed for 30% bonus true damage over 3 seconds.
trait.da_18_executioner.description: Executioners gain Precision and 15% Critical Strike Chance.
trait.da_18_executioner.name: Executioner
trait.da_18_fae.breakpoint.4.description: 8% and 4% Heal. After attracting 7 Pixies, start attracting Golden Pixies instead which grant gold.
trait.da_18_fae.description:
Your team's damage, healing, and shielding attracts Pixies.
Each Pixie grants Fae champions Attack Damage and Ability Power, and after they fall below 50% Health, they heal for each Pixie.
trait.da_18_fae.name: Fae
trait.da_18_greenfather.description:
Gain 1 seed when your strongest Ivern casts, plus 3 every combat. Ivern uses 5 seeds to grow a hex on your board that grants a bonus to its occupant.
Seeds: 0 / 5
Current Biome:
trait.da_18_greenfather.name: Greenfather
trait.da_18_hunter.description: Hunters gain Attack Damage. If a Hunter hasn't swapped targets for 3 seconds, they gain 10% Damage Amp.
trait.da_18_hunter.name: Hunter
trait.da_18_inferno.breakpoint.3.descrip: After combat, 1 of your shop slots without an Inferno champion ignites, rolling a champion one tier higher
trait.da_18_inferno.description: Inferno damage Burns and Wounds enemies for 3 seconds. Inferno Burns stack with other Burns.
trait.da_18_inferno.name: Inferno
trait.da_18_invoker.description: Your team gains Mana Regen, increased for Invokers.
trait.da_18_invoker.name: Invoker
trait.da_18_lunar.description: Lunar champions and adjacent allies gain Attack Speed and Ability Power. Lunar champions gain 100% more.
trait.da_18_lunar.name: Lunar
trait.da_18_luxuniquetrait.description:
Having an Avatar on your bench or board transforms all other Avatars in your shop to the Trait of that Avatar.
An Avatar's chosen Trait is counted twice for Trait bonuses.
trait.da_18_luxuniquetrait.name: Avatar
trait.da_18_maokai_uniquetrait.descripti:
Whenever an enemy within 3 hexes dies, your strongest Old Growth champion gains 30 permanent max Health.
Current: 0
trait.da_18_maokai_uniquetrait.name: Old Growth
trait.da_18_rapidfire.description: Your team gains 10% Attack Speed. Rapidfire champions gain more on every attack, up to 10 stacks.
trait.da_18_rapidfire.name: Rapidfire
trait.da_18_rival.breakpoint.1.descripti:
Rivals collect takedowns, gaining 3 if they takedown another Rival.
Takedowns evolve Kha'Zix, permanently granting him your choice of Executioner, Rapidfire, Ravager, or Spellweaver.
Rengar grants 2/3/5 gold every 8 takedowns. After 30 takedowns, your team gains 5% Attack Damage plus 0.2% AD per additional takedown.
Kha'Zix Takedowns: 0 / 0
Rengar Takedowns: 0
Gold Earned: 0

trait.da_18_slayer.name: Ravager
trait.da_18_solar.breakpoint.3.descripti:
Your champions gain a 5% max Health shield and deal 8% bonus magic damage. Gain additional bonuses for each unique 3-star champion:
1 : Increase shield and magic damage by 1% for each 3-star.
3 : 15% Attack Speed and 15 Armor and Magic Resist
5 : Convert 40% of the bonus magic damage to true damage.
8 : Every 4 seconds of combat, a 3-star champion ascends to 4-star.
trait.da_18_solar.description:
Your champions gain a 5% max Health shield and deal 8% bonus magic damage. Gain additional bonuses for each unique 3-star champion:
1 : Increase shield and magic damage by 1% for each 3-star.
3 : 15% Attack Speed and 15 Armor and Magic Resist
5 : Convert 40% of the bonus magic damage to true damage.
8 : Every 4 seconds of combat, a 3-star champion ascends to 4-star.

trait.da_18_spellweaver.description: Your team gains 10% Ability Power. Spellweavers gain more, plus extra Ability Power whenever a Spellweaver casts an Ability.
trait.da_18_spellweaver.name: Spellweaver
trait.da_18_sprykin.breakpoint.3.descrip:
The Rider gains
15% Health and 15% Attack Speed
trait.da_18_sprykin.breakpoint.5.descrip: 40% Health 35% Attack Speed , and 50% of the BFF's Ability applies to your Sprykin champions.
trait.da_18_sprykin.breakpoint.7.descrip: 45% Health 45% Attack Speed , and 100% of the BFF's Ability applies to your Sprykin champions.
trait.da_18_sprykin.description: Gain the Big Furry Friend. Drop a Sprykin on the BFF to pick its Rider.
trait.da_18_sprykin.name: Sprykin
trait.da_18_summoner.description:
Summoners empower their summons in different ways.
Yorick: +30% Health
Azir: +20% Damage
Mama Beak: +45% Damage
Zyra: +4 Plant Attacks
trait.da_18_summoner.name: Summoner
trait.da_18_vanguard.breakpoint.6.descri: 40% max Health. Gain 5% Durability while Shielded.
trait.da_18_vanguard.description: At Combat Start and after dropping below 50% Health, Vanguards gain a max Health Shield for 10 seconds.
trait.da_18_vanguard.name: Vanguard
trait.da_18_zyrauniquetrait.description: Your team gains 5% Durability, increased to 10% if 6 or more Zyra plants are alive.
trait.da_18_zyrauniquetrait.name: Thornmaiden
trait.da_aluneuniquetrait18.description: Your strongest Alune cycles to a new phase of the moon after each cast. While the moon is at or below half full, your team gains 7% Durabilty. While above, your team gains 7% Damage Amp.
trait.da_aluneuniquetrait18.name: Attuned
trait.da_dravenuniquetrait18.description: Choose a bounty. Your strongest Draven can progress on the bounty to earn its reward. Upon completing a bounty, choose another.
trait.da_dravenuniquetrait18.name: Bounty Seeker
trait.da_emerald18.description: Drag an ally onto your strongest Taric to pair them, granting the ally powerful bonuses from Taric's Ability.
trait.da_emerald18.name: Emerald Aspect
trait.da_florafatalis18.breakpoint.2.des: and grant a 8% max Health heal to the lowest Health ally.

trait.da_florafatalis18.name: Flora Fatalis
trait.da_juggernaut18.description: Your team gains Durability. Juggernauts gain more.
trait.da_juggernaut18.name: Juggernaut
trait.da_primal18.description: Choose one of four Primal Blessings.
trait.da_primal18.name: Primal

trait.da_riftbeast18.breakpoint.5.descri: Every 3 combats, your next shop is overrun with Riftbeasts.

On combat start and every 5 seconds Riftbeasts grow gaining
